name: New Jersey Motorsports Park Thunderbolt Raceway (Thunderbolt)

career.lengthSource: New Jersey Motorsports Park official track map | https://njmp.com/track-map/
career.layoutCall: Thunderbolt, 2019 Classic route with both chicanes (2.25 mi, 3.621 km): F1600 Championship Series, September 2019. The 2023-24 repave widened the Turn 1 entry by an unconfirmed amount and the 2025-26 'Devil's Pass' branch came after; this model is today's OSM line along the Classic route, so the Turn 1 entry width is approximate (research notes table). OSM's loop measures 3504 m, 3.2% under the published length.
